text: Marek Barros scored an amazing long-range goal from nearly 44 meters out to put Harbour City 2-0 up against Seabrook Town just after halftime[#975]. The goal came after a patient 29-second build-up starting from a corner, with Barros first setting up a cross and then finishing off the rebound himself[#972]. Harbour City controlled the ball well in the final minutes, with over half the possession and accurate passing, letting them carefully create chances like this. This goal showed their calm style paying off against Seabrook’s wide crossing game.
